confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are medium confidence. They come from aggregator and travel-guide estimates (not official price lists), and the restaurant and beer figures are the strongest. Cocktail and wine are lower confidence: they rest on overlapping guide ranges and, for wine, a single anecdote. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Gothenburg's market, with no accommodation searches or live listings checked; they are low to medium confidence and may not reflect July 2026 peak-season rates. The FX value is a third-party reproduction of an RBA observation dated 2026-10-27 (AllRatesToday, 0.7021). I did not verify it on rba.gov.au, and it is not the latest observation available on the generation date (2026-11-19). Treat it as provisional until checked against the RBA F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized Swedish city with tourism demand, positioned below Stockholm and in line with other Nordic mid-sized cities for restaurants and bars. Food anchors use SEK price ranges converted at roughly 9.5 SEK per USD. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a mid-sized Scandinavian port city in peak summer.
